class Record:

class Node:

        self.children = []


def BuildTree(records):
    if not records:

    # Records must be a full, continuous set of ids 0..n-1
    ordered = sorted(records, key=lambda r: r.record_id)
    ids = [r.record_id for r in ordered]

            nodes[record.parent_id].children.append(nodes[record.record_id])
